nodes.name: Cal Webhook
nodes.notes:
Register this URL at Cal.com -> Settings -> Developer -> Webhooks for BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_CANCELLED.

AUTH: Cal.com does NOT support custom auth headers -- it signs the raw body with HMAC-SHA256 and sends X-Cal-Signature-256. n8n's Header Auth therefore cannot be used here (it would reject every delivery). The unguessable path segment acts as the shared secret instead; treat this whole URL as a credential.

UPGRADE PATH: set a `secret` on the Cal.com webhook and verify X-Cal-Signature-256 in a Code node against the raw body before trusting the payload.

responseMode onReceived returns 200 immediately so Cal never waits on our CRM writes.

nodes.name: Normalise Cal Event
nodes.notes: Flattens Cal's { triggerEvent, payload } envelope and derives matchUid / newUid / sessionId.

nodes.name: Apply Booking Event
nodes.notes: Single statement: matches on the old uid (or session_id), writes the new uid, status, start time and meeting_booked, and RETURNs the row so we get crm_lead_id / crm_task_id without a second query.

nodes.name: Resolve Run
nodes.notes: Returns [] for bookings with no agent_runs row -- a booking made outside the agent. Stops the branch quietly.

nodes.name: AutoCRM Login
nodes.notes: Same cookie-auth bootstrap as the events workflow. Login is CSRF-exempt.

nodes.name: IF Has Task
nodes.notes: Runs before lead_created recorded a task, or for bookings made outside the agent, crm_task_id is null. Skip the PATCH instead of hitting /api/tasks/undefined.

nodes.name: Update Prep Task
nodes.notes: PATCH, never POST. A reschedule moves due_at on the SAME task; a cancel sets status canceled. 'canceled' is the single-l spelling AutoCRM's TASK_STATUSES uses. Non-fatal: losing the task edit must not lose the notification.

parameters.subject: ={{ $('Resolve Run').item.json.isCancel ? 'Meeting CANCELLED' : 'Meeting rescheduled' }} — {{ $('Resolve Run').item.json.visitorName }}
parameters.text:
={{ $('Resolve Run').item.json.isCancel
  ? 'The visitor cancelled their meeting on Cal.com.\n\n'
    + 'Who:    ' + $('Resolve Run').item.json.visitorName + ' (' + $('Resolve Run').item.json.visitorEmail + ')\n'
    + 'Was at: ' + $('Resolve Run').item.json.whenLocal + '\n'
    + ($('Resolve Run').item.json.cancellationReason ? 'Reason: ' + $('Resolve Run').item.json.cancellationReason + '\n' : '')
    + '\nThe prep task has been marked canceled.'
  : 'The visitor moved their meeting on Cal.com.\n\n'
    + 'Who:      ' + $('Resolve Run').item.json.visitorName + ' (' + $('Resolve Run').item.json.visitorEmail + ')\n'
    + 'New time: ' + $('Resolve Run').item.json.whenLocal + '\n'
    + 'Join:     ' + $('Resolve Run').item.json.meetingUrl + '\n'
    + '\nThe task deadline has been updated.'
}}

AutoCRM lead: {{ $env.AUTOCRM_BASE_URL }}/leads/{{ $('Resolve Run').item.json.crm_lead_id }}

nodes.name: Record Failure
nodes.notes: Falls back to a synthetic 'cal-uid:...' session id when the payload had no metadata, so a cancel failure is still recorded somewhere rather than lost.
